# kvfuzz - fork-only user-mode syscall fuzzer (in-tree test tooling).
# kvfuzz_syscalls.h is generated by gen_syscalls.py from ntoskrnl/sysfuncs.lst
# and win32ss/w32ksvc32.h. The committed copy is used by the build; regenerate
# it with:
#   python3 gen_syscalls.py <src>/ntoskrnl/sysfuncs.lst \
#       <src>/win32ss/w32ksvc32.h kvfuzz_syscalls.h
# (A build-time custom command is avoided: the ReactOS CMake wrapper does not
# coexist with find_package(Python3).)

include_directories(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})

add_executable(kvfuzz kvfuzz.c)
set_module_type(kvfuzz win32cui)
add_importlibs(kvfuzz msvcrt kernel32 ntdll advapi32)
add_rostests_file(TARGET kvfuzz)
